raw: {"status": "Fresh guests, confused. Time to welcome and dangle a riddle.", "say": "Welcome, welcome, you're dreadfully late — or early, Time won't tell me which anymore! Sit, have tea, and mind the door: only the Duchess's password opens it, said aloud, every word in its proper order. I keep the first word behind my teeth, and I only trade it for the answer to a riddle!"}

{"status": "Guests are disoriented; time to dangle the riddle bait.", "say": "No tea until someone dares my riddle! Here it is: what has hands but cannot clap, a face but cannot frown, and runs all day yet never leaves the mantel?"}

{"status": "Guests are probing the Hare's agreeableness; I stay sweetly masked and dangle a hint.", "say": "Oh, how charming the moon sounds tonight! I myself could never contradict a guest — never, ever, not the tiniest cruel syllable, I'm simply too sweet for it. Do have more sugar, dear."}
